definitions.explanation: The act of purchasing goods or materials for resale or business use. Also refers to the wholesale price or cost of goods purchased.
Figuratively, the process of gathering information, knowledge, or material for a particular purpose.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{市場|いちば}で{新鮮|しんせん}な{魚|さかな}を{仕入|しい}れる。
examples.english: Every morning, I purchase fresh fish at the market.

examples.japanese: {仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}が{上|あ}がって{利益|りえき}が{減|へ}った。
examples.english: The purchase price went up and profits decreased.

examples.japanese: {記者|きしゃ}は{情報|じょうほう}の{仕入|しい}れに{走|はし}り{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: The reporter ran around gathering information.

notes:
DERIVED FROM:
The verb {仕入|しい}れる (to stock up, to purchase for business).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{仕入|しい}れ{値|ね} - purchase price, wholesale cost
・{仕入|しい}れ{先|さき} - supplier, source of goods
・{仕入|しい}れ{担当|たんとう} - purchasing manager
・{仕入|しい}れコスト - procurement cost

BUSINESS CONTEXT:
・{仕入|しい}れが{入|はい}る - stock arrives
・{仕入|しい}れを{確保|かくほ}する - to secure supplies
・{仕入|しい}れルート - supply route/channel

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{仕入|しい}れる - to purchase, stock up (verb)
・{卸|おろし} - wholesale
・{在庫|ざいこ} - inventory, stock
・{発注|はっちゅう} - placing an order
・{調達|ちょうたつ} - procurement

FIGURATIVE USE:
{ネタの仕入|しい}れ - gathering material (for writing, comedy, etc.)

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in business contexts and everyday commercial activities.
